title: Ultimate Kilimanjaro Trek & Tanzania Safari Adventure
content:
This ultimate combo adventure combines the thrill of summiting Mount Kilimanjaro via the scenic Lemosho Route with the wonders of Tanzania’s world-class wildlife safaris. Starting with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport, your journey begins with a comfortable stay in a hotel, complete with a pre-trekking briefing to prepare you for the adventure ahead. The Kilimanjaro climb takes you through diverse landscapes, from lush rainforests to alpine deserts, culminating at the majestic Uhuru Peak.

Each day balances challenging treks with opportunities for acclimatization and breathtaking views, all supported by experienced guides, skilled porters, and exceptional hospitality at every campsite.

Following your descent, the adventure continues with a safari through Tanzania’s renowned national parks. Experience the stunning Tarangire National Park, the iconic Serengeti National Park with its vast savannas and rich wildlife, and the unique Ngorongoro Crater, a haven for diverse species. Along the way, enjoy cultural interactions in Mto wa Mbu village and unwind in carefully selected lodges and camps that enhance your connection to Tanzania’s natural beauty. This well-rounded itinerary promises an unforgettable blend of trekking triumphs and thrilling wildlife encounters.

Where you stay

At Salinero Hotels we do not believe in numbers but we do believe in a service keeping our few customers happy around the clock. Salinero Kilimanjaro is Located 3 Km from Moshi town center in the Leafy suburb of shanty town.

The hotel now blends in simplistic elegance with perfect architectural designs all combined to entice even the most seasoned traveller. Now operating as a 30-room unit, we ensure that clients enjoy personalized service around the clock whilst staying with us. Our well manicured gardens provide the ample settings for your wedding reception or any other special event that you may have.

Endoro Lodge is an Eco friendly safari lodge located on the slops of Ngorongoro highland forest. We have beautiful chalet rooms which are uniquely designed to give our clients an authentic African experience. Our highly skilled stuff uphold the slogan which is integrate with nature for they are all dressed in authentic Masai cloths.

Welcome to our enchanting midrange tented camp, a hidden gem in the heart of the Central Serengeti. Our lodge offers a perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort, providing a memorable safari experience for our guests. We invite you to embark on a journey of discovery, where the wonders of nature meet the comforts of home for an unforgettable safari getaway.

faqs.title: What is included in the Tanzania Combo Package?
faqs.content: Our Tanzania Combo Packages include a combination of a Mount Kilimanjaro climb, a thrilling safari experience, and a relaxing stay in Zanzibar. We provide expert guides, park fees, accommodation, meals, and transportation for the entire trip, so you can focus on enjoying your adventure. You can customize your itinerary based on your preferences.

faqs.title: How long does the combo trip last?
faqs.content: The length of the combo trip varies depending on the itinerary you choose. Typically, the Kilimanjaro climb takes 6 to 8 days, followed by 3 to 4 days on safari in top parks like Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater, and 4 to 5 days in Zanzibar. The total trip can range from 10 to 14 days, depending on your preferences.

faqs.title: Do I need any prior experience for climbing Mount Kilimanjaro?
faqs.content: No prior climbing experience is required. However, you should be in good physical condition to handle the altitude and trekking. Our guides will support you throughout the climb, and we recommend some fitness training before your trip. The right preparation will help ensure a safe and enjoyable climb.

faqs.title: What are the best months to visit Tanzania for the combo package?
faqs.content: The best time to visit Tanzania for a combo trip is during the dry seasons, typically from June to October and December to February. These months offer ideal weather for both climbing Mount Kilimanjaro and going on safari, as wildlife is easier to spot, and the conditions are favorable for trekking.

faqs.title: Can I customize my safari experience within the combo package?
faqs.content: Yes! Our combo packages are flexible, and you can customize your safari experience based on your interests. Whether you want to focus on seeing the Big Five, experiencing the Great Migration, or enjoying a private safari with a personal guide, we can tailor the safari to your preferences.

faqs.title: What type of accommodation can I expect during the combo trip?
faqs.content: We offer a variety of accommodation options based on your comfort preferences. For the Kilimanjaro trek, you’ll stay in mountain huts or camping facilities. On safari, you can enjoy luxury lodges and tented camps, depending on your choice. In Zanzibar, we provide a range of options from beachfront resorts to boutique hotels, ensuring a comfortable and relaxing stay.

itinerary.title: Day 1
itinerary.content:
As you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our dedicated driver will be there to warmly greet you, holding a sign with your name for a personal touch. You will then enjoy a seamless transfer to the enchanting to your Hotel, where a delicious meal awaits you. Following this, our experienced mountain coordinators and your guide will conduct a pre-trekking briefing, giving you valuable insights into the wonders that lie ahead during your expedition.

Take the time to unwind and enjoy the relaxing environment of your Hotel, which features a swimming pool, a beautiful garden, a bar, and a restaurant. This setting provides the perfect opportunity to prepare for your upcoming adventure while ensuring your comfort and relaxation before you begin your trek.

Overnight: Sal salinero hotel or similar

itinerary.title: Day 2
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 2,200 m - 2,780 m
  • Hiking distance: 7 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours time

On your first day, you’ll begin with breakfast and a briefing from your guide at your Hotel. Following this, you’ll embark on a 1.5-hour drive to Lemosho Park Gate (2,100m). Once you arrive at Lemosho Gate, you’ll complete the necessary registration before starting your trek.

Your adventure begins with a hike along scenic forest trails to Mti Mkubwa Campsite (2,750m). This trek typically takes around 3 hours. Upon reaching the campsite, the porters will set up your tents, and our chef will prepare a delicious lunch for you.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some time to relax and acclimate to your surroundings. In the evening, your guide will provide a briefing about the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re well-prepared for the adventures that lie ahead. This day sets the tone for your expedition, combining travel, nature, and preparation for the exciting days to come.

itinerary.title: Day 3
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 2,780 m – 3,500 m
  • Hiking distance: 8 km
  • Hiking time: 4–5 hours

On the second day, you’ll start your morning early with breakfast before setting off on a trek from Mti Mkubwa Camp to Shira 1 Camp. This hike typically takes up to 5 hours and offers spectacular views of the west face of Kibo Volcano, the highest peak of Kilimanjaro. As you traverse the lower moorland zone, you’ll encounter large shrubs and vibrant wildflowers that add to the stunning scenery. Upon reaching Shira 1 Camp, our porters will set up your tents while the chef prepares a nourishing lunch.

After enjoying your meal, you’ll have some well-deserved time to relax and acclimate to the altitude. In the evening, your guide will hold a briefing to discuss the plans for the next day’s trek, ensuring you’re informed and ready for the adventure ahead. This day offers not only a chance to make progress on your climb but also to appreciate the diverse flora and breathtaking views that Kilimanjaro has to offer.

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,500m – 3,840 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 3 -4 hours

On the third day, you’ll start your morning with an early breakfast before embarking on a brief hike from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp. This trek typically takes about 5 to 6 hours and is relatively easy, allowing you to fully enjoy the breathtaking views of the African landscape around you. Upon arrival at Shira 2 Camp, our dedicated porters will handle all the arrangements, including pitching your tents, while the chef prepares a delicious lunch. After your meal, you’ll have the opportunity to unwind and rest until dinnertime.

In the evening, after dinner, your experienced guide will hold a briefing to discuss the trekking plans for the following day. This day not only allows for gradual acclimatization but also offers stunning panoramic vistas, making it a memorable part of your Kilimanjaro adventure.

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.desc: SHIRA CAMP 2 | LAVA TOWER | BARRANCO CAMP
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,840 m – 3,960 m
  • Hiking distance: 11 km
  • Hiking time: 7–8 hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek. Today’s route takes you to the Lava Tower at 4,630 meters, traversing through a semi-desert, rocky landscape. This demanding hike typically takes around 5 hours to reach the Lava Tower, where you’ll enjoy lunch amidst the stunning surroundings. After lunch, prepare for a descent of 680 meters to Barranco Camp, which allows your body to adjust to the higher altitude—a key advantage of acclimatization. The 2-hour descent offers breathtaking views and fantastic photo opportunities of the Western Breach, a striking feature of Kilimanjaro’s landscape.

Conclude your day with a memorable sunset and dinner at Barranco Camp, where you can reflect on the day’s achievements and recharge for the adventures ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, helping you adapt to the altitude while enjoying the diverse and stunning terrains of Kilimanjaro.

itinerary.title: Day 6
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,960 m – 4,035 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day early with a wake-up call and a nourishing breakfast to fuel your trek. The journey may include ascending the famous Barranco Wall, a steep but rewarding section that provides breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. After conquering the Wall, you’ll descend into the scenic Karanga Valley, renowned for its lush vegetation and stunning vistas.

Upon reaching the Karanga Campsite, our dedicated porters will set up your tents while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, you’ll embark on an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp, ascending 200 meters before returning to camp. This acclimatization hike is essential for your body to adjust to the altitude and helps prepare you for the final summit push.

In the evening, enjoy a hot meal prepared by our chef, providing the nourishment you’ll need for the upcoming challenges. Following dinner, your experienced guide will brief you on the next day’s trek, discussing the route, challenges, and key details to ensure you’re well-prepared for the adventure ahead. This day is vital for acclimatization, allowing you to appreciate the stunning beauty of Kilimanjaro while ensuring you are physically ready for the summit attempt.

itinerary.title: Day 7
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,035 m – 4,640 m
  • Hiking distance: 5 km
  • Hiking time: 5 hours

Start your day with an early wake-up call and a hearty breakfast to fuel your trek toward Barafu Campsite. The trail features varied terrain, including rocky sections and gradual slopes, offering breathtaking views of Kilimanjaro’s high-altitude landscapes. As you ascend, it’s crucial to focus on acclimatization to minimize the risk of altitude-related issues.

Upon reaching Barafu, our dedicated porters will handle the setup of your camp while our chef prepares a satisfying lunch. After your meal, take time to rest and recharge until dinner. In the evening, your guide will brief you on the upcoming summit attempt, covering important details about the route, challenges, safety measures, and preparations.

Make sure to rest well this evening, as the summit ascent will begin late at night. This preparation is key for a successful climb to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa, where you’ll experience the thrill of standing atop Kilimanjaro.

itinerary.title: Day 8
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 4,640 m – 5, 895 m – 3,090 m
  • Hiking distance: 17 km
  • Hiking & descending time: 15+ hours

On this crucial day, you’ll rise around 11:30 PM and start your ascent after enjoying some tea and biscuits. The climb begins as you head northwest, navigating through scree toward Stella Point on the crater rim. The trek to Stella Point, located at 5,685 meters, is often considered the most mentally and physically demanding portion of the climb, typically taking around 6 hours. Upon reaching Stella Point, take a brief rest to absorb the breathtaking views and, if conditions allow, witness a magnificent sunrise. The journey continues with a 2-hour snow-covered ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa. Your time at the summit should be brief due to the cold and potential fatigue, so make sure to capture the moment quickly.

Afterward, you will descend back to Barafu Camp, a trek that takes about 3 hours, where you’ll have a chance for a short rest before continuing on to Mweka Camp for dinner and your overnight stay. This day is a true highlight of your Kilimanjaro adventure, culminating in a sense of accomplishment that is unmatched.

itinerary.title: Day 9
itinerary.desc: MWEKA CAMP | MWEKA PARK GATE | MOSHI
itinerary.content:
• Altitude: 3,090 m – 1,650 m
  • Hiking distance: 10 km
  • descending time: 4-5 hours

After breakfast at Mweka Camp, you’ll begin your descent to Mweka Gate, where you’ll complete the trek. A comfortable drive will take you back to your Hotel, where a hot lunch and a refreshing shower await you. At the end of your trip, tipping your guide and the support team is encouraged and appreciated; special envelopes for this purpose will be available at the hotel.

As this is a combo package, you will receive a pre-safari briefing in the late afternoon. Our safari coordinator will meet with you at the hotel to provide detailed information about your upcoming safari adventure and answer any questions you may have. This briefing will ensure you’re fully prepared for the exciting experiences ahead!

itinerary.title: Day 10
itinerary.content:
Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a drive to Tarangire National Park, a prime destination for exceptional wildlife viewing. Known for its vibrant animal populations, especially in the dry season, Tarangire attracts vast herds gathering around its life-sustaining river. The park’s varied scenery—ranging from lush savannahs and swamps to rugged hills and towering baobabs—offers an impressive backdrop to observe elephants, zebras, buffalo, and sometimes lions and oryx as they roam in search of water.

Bird enthusiasts will appreciate the abundant birdlife, while the Tarangire River remains a crucial water source throughout the dry months. After this immersive day of safari exploration, unwind overnight at Endoro Lodge or a similar accommodation, preparing for more adventures ahead.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 11
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, set off toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The route takes you through the rugged and beautiful landscapes surrounding the park, giving you glimpses of Maasai villages and the open plains that define this world-famous ecosystem. The Serengeti, known for its vast savannas and the renowned Great Migration, offers a chance to spot a diverse range of wildlife, including lions, cheetahs, elephants, and more.

Arrive in the Serengeti in time for an afternoon game drive, where you can experience the thrill of spotting wildlife against the park’s iconic landscapes. In the evening, unwind and enjoy dinner at your Serengeti Camp, resting up for more exploration the next day.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 12
itinerary.content:
Prepare for a full day of exploration in the Serengeti! After an early breakfast, embark on morning and afternoon game drives across the iconic savannas. The Serengeti offers unmatched opportunities for wildlife viewing, where you’ll have the chance to see large prides of lions, and leopards lounging in acacia trees, and herds of wildebeest and zebra roaming the plains.

Your guide will help you track the movements of different animals, potentially witnessing hunting scenes and interactions that reveal the complex dynamics of the Serengeti ecosystem. Enjoy a picnic lunch amid the park’s breathtaking landscapes, then continue your adventure until sunset. Return to your lodge for a restful evening under the Serengeti stars.

Overnight: Serengeti central lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 13
itinerary.desc: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater and Karatu
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, begin your scenic drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, home to the breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater. Upon arrival, descend into the crater to witness its incredible wildlife and striking landscapes. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, often referred to as the “Eighth Wonder of the World,” is teeming with diverse animals, including elephants, lions, rhinos, and flamingos.

After an unforgettable day of exploring the crater, drive to the nearby Karatu area and check into Endoro Lodge or similar, where you can relax and reflect on your remarkable experiences in the heart of Tanzania’s wildlife.

Overnight: Endoro Lodge or similar

itinerary.title: Day 14
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, you’ll embark on a unique cultural experience in Mto wa Mbu, a vibrant village located at the base of the Great Rift Valley. Known for its diverse communities and rich cultural heritage, Mto wa Mbu offers an authentic glimpse into Tanzanian village life. You’ll have the opportunity to explore local markets, interact with artisans, and learn about traditional farming practices.

A guided walk through the village will introduce you to the fascinating history and the many ethnic groups that call this area home. Experience local cuisine, try your hand at traditional crafts, and gain insight into the agricultural methods that sustain the community. After a day of cultural immersion, you’ll drive back to Moshi in the late afternoon, reflecting on your unforgettable safari and cultural experiences.

Overnight: Salinero Hotel or Similar

itinerary.title: Day 15
itinerary.content:
On your departure day, you have the flexibility to transfer back to Kilimanjaro International Airport (KIA) or explore additional options to extend your adventure. If you’re interested in experiencing more of Tanzania, consider adding a day trip. Visit our Day Trip page to discover various excursions, including cultural experiences and scenic tours.

Alternatively, if you’re looking to relax on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar, check out our Zanzibar page for options to extend your stay on this stunning island. We’re here to help you make the most of your journey, so let us know how you’d like to proceed!
